# attestation artifact

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestationArtifact`](gmeow-attestationArtifact.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestationArtifact>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The concrete carrier (in-toto JSON, VC, DSSE envelope, C2PA manifest, etc.) that embodies an attestation. Non-functional: an attestation may be carried by multiple equivalent artifacts under different formats.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) -> [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attestationArtifact`](gmeow-attestationArtifact.md) from [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) to [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

    gmeow:attestedSubject    ex:release ;
    gmeow:attestationType    gmeow:attestationTypeSLSAProvenance ;
    gmeow:issuedAt           "2026-06-14T12:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ;
    gmeow:attestationArtifact ex:artifact ;
    gmeow:hasSignature       ex:sig ;
    gmeow:verificationResult ex:verifyResult .

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link the logical [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) to the concrete serialization that carries it — an in-toto JSON, DSSE envelope, VC, or C2PA manifest — when the byte-level carrier matters for retrieval or re-verification.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the broad attestation kind ([`gmeow:attestationType`](gmeow-attestationType.md)) or the cryptographic signature over the bytes ([`gmeow:hasSignature`](gmeow-hasSignature.md)); the artifact is the document, not the category or the signature.

### How to use

- Point the [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) at one or more [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md) carriers, each with [`gmeow:artifactMediaType`](gmeow-artifactMediaType.md) and a [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md); assert several when the same vouching act is serialized in equivalent formats (it is non-functional).

### Examples

- ex:provAtt [`gmeow:attestationArtifact`](gmeow-attestationArtifact.md) ex:inTotoJson.
